stem: Which process is a defining feature of brain maturation during adolescence, involving the reduction of neuronal connections?
explanation: This process involves the elimination of excess synapses to increase the efficiency of the remaining neuronal pathways.
rationale: Think of this like a gardener removing excess branches to help a tree grow stronger.

optionExplanations.A: This process involves the elimination of excess synapses to increase the efficiency of the remaining neuronal pathways.
optionExplanations.B: While myelination is part of development, the source describes a reduction of connections rather than a pause in insulation growth.
optionExplanations.C: Gray matter mass actually decreases following a peak in early adolescence as part of the maturation process.
optionExplanations.D: The lecture highlights the reduction and refinement of connections rather than an overall thickening of the cortex during this phase.
